commits.message: Added a custom name field to plugin db table. This value is used as an item in the left menu.
Added file db_admin.php from my previous work. It is the main file of the plugin. It needs some sanitation/validation among other changes.
A bug that causes no change while editing solved.

Changed exports: Found results may now be exported as regex also. There may be exported more fields at once.
Added some WikiApi features: login, revisions, edittoken and edit.
Added equalsTo method to WikiPage: checks whether two pages have the same last revision, i. e. are the same page. Usage: check in the api if the page loaded from the db dump has been editted.

A few bugs solved and removed: bug that renders pageText of every WikiTalkPage empty, bug that lets confirmEditIndex grow without bounds so that the program freezes after last edit, bug that makes query checkboxes behave oddly and sets text of a JCheckBox instead of a JTextField while parsing criteria.

JTextFields for text replacement and creation (page replace, talk page replace, talk page create) have been changed to JTextAreas so newline characters can be used. JPanels and JLabels changed to local variables.

Initial commit: Initial version of the project. The program can search xml wikidumps. GUI is in czech. It's tested on the www.WikiSkripta.eu project, others wikimedia, other languages and wikimedia API communications are yet to be done.
